records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 8 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water. Harvest with the scythe.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang mahinog. Mas mabilis lumaki kapag itinanim malapit sa anyong-tubig. Anihin gamit ang Karit.

records.source: Occasionally shields the wearer from damage.
records.translation: Paminsan-minsang pinoprotektahan ang nagsusuot mula sa pinsala.

records.source: A rare jelly found in freshwater.

records.englishResidueReason: Hazelnut is the established Filipino loan name for this nut.

records.source: The roasting process creates a rich forest flavor.
records.translation: Lumilikha ang pag-iihaw ng malinamnam na lasa ng kagubatan.

records.source: Fresh fish eggs. These can be aged in a preserves jar to bring out more flavor.
records.translation: Mga sariwang itlog ng isda. Maaaring ipaedad ang mga ito sa Garapon ng Preserba upang lalong lumabas ang lasa.

records.source: This'll get you digging for more.
Decomposing organic material. It's slimy and unpleasant.
records.translation: Nabubulok na organikong bagay. Madulas at hindi kaaya-aya.

records.source: A precious stone that is sought after for its rich color and beautiful luster.
records.translation: Mahalagang batong hinahanap-hanap dahil sa matingkad na kulay at magandang kintab.
Pinatataas nang 10% ang lakas ng pag-atake.
Basagin upang makakuha ng mga rubi.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o palamutian ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: A well preserved cog that must have been part of some ancient machine. This could be dwarven technology.
records.translation: Mahusay na napanatiling enggranahe na malamang bahagi ng isang sinaunang makina. Maaaring teknolohiya ito ng mga Duwende.

records.source: A plain old spoon, probably ten years old. Not very interesting.
records.translation: Payak na lumang kutsara na marahil sampung taon na. Hindi gaanong kawili-wili.

records.source: An old spur that was once attached to a cowboy's boot. People must have been raising animals in this area for many generations.
records.translation: Lumang espuelang dating nakakabit sa bota ng koboy. Malamang maraming salinlahi nang nag-aalaga ng hayop ang mga tao sa lugar na ito.

records.preserveReason: Salmon is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fish species.

records.source: Swims upstream to lay its eggs.
records.translation: Lumalangoy pasalungat sa agos upang mangitlog.

records.preserveReason: Salmonberry is the fictional berry name used consistently throughout existing Filipino dialogue and glossary text.

records.source: A spring-time berry with the flavor of the forest.
records.translation: Maliit na bunga sa tagsibol na may lasa ng kagubatan.

records.englishResidueReason: Salmon is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fish species.

records.source: The lemon spritz makes it special.
records.translation: Ginagawa itong natatangi ng wisik ng limon.

records.preserveReason: Sandfish is the fictional fish name used consistently in existing Filipino quest text.

records.source: It tries to hide using camouflage.
records.translation: Sinusubukan nitong magtago sa pamamagitan ng pagbabalatkayo.

records.source: A common type of stone with red and brown striations.
records.translation: Karaniwang uri ng batong may pula at kayumangging mga guhit.
